scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm on Replit for workspace support" >&2 ;; esac'
scripts.start: pnpm --filter @workspace/asateen-game run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.dev:api: cd artifacts/api-server && node build.mjs && node dist/index.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
